daily.description: The standing morning desk - triage service, chase renewals, work new leads, close with a digest.

items.task: Triage every open service ticket against SLA, propose engineer and slot for each, and flag anything that will breach.
Work the new and contacted leads: enrich each with what we can establish from our records, and route the ones worth pursuing.
Find contracts inside the renewal window or already lapsed, and prepare the renewal approach for each.
Write the end-of-desk digest: pipeline, service exposure, renewals at risk, and what needs a human today.

renewals.description: AMC/CMC renewal push across the whole book.

items.task: Sweep every contract expiring within the policy window plus all lapsed ones; prepare a renewal approach and outreach for each, tier by tier.

service.description: Service desk only - triage, schedule, and escalate.

items.task: Triage all open and awaiting-customer tickets, assign engineers by region and skill, and escalate SLA risk.
Enrich every lead with status new or contacted and hand the qualified ones onward.
